lion.desc: a chubby baby lion cub with a big round fluffy orange mane made of puffy round tufts, a small yellow curl on top of the head, soft yellow plush body, cream muzzle, small brown nose, rosy cheeks, round ears, teal denim overall shorts with a yellow sun embroidered on the bib pocket and orange buttons, thin tail with an orange tuft

otter.desc: a chubby baby otter with brown plush fur, cream face and belly, whiskers, small round ears, a coral-orange vest with yellow buttons and two pockets, a long thick brown tail

elephant.desc: a chubby baby elephant with lavender plush skin, big ears with pink insides, a small purple tuft of hair on top, eyelashes, rosy cheeks, a pale yellow romper with a scalloped cream collar, yellow buttons and puffy bloomer shorts, a thin tail with a purple tuft
